description: Channel governance hash-chain (SPEC §8.3.1). A descriptor change (here: add an admin) is a NEW kind-30110 at the SAME d-tag with supersedes -> the prior descriptor_id, signed by the founder OR a prior-epoch admin. Proves the new descriptor is a distinct content-addressed artifact (different descriptor_id) replacing the prior one at one d-tag, so governance is tamper-evident + offline-verifiable. A replacement not signed by a prior-epoch admin/founder is E_CH_UNAUTHORIZED.
notes: v2 adds an admin + sets supersedes=v1 descriptor_id. descriptor_v2_id = hex(sha256(canonical(v2)+'\n')). Both share the channel_id-derived d-tag (vc14) so v2 (addressable, NIP-33) replaces v1 at conforming relays; the ids differ. A conforming client accepts v2 only if signed by the founder or an admin present in v1's admins set.
